description: This file contains functions for managing cgroups v2 paths and controllers, including checking available controllers, creating cgroup paths, and handling controller states.

methods.name: supportedControllers
methods.description: Returns the list of supported cgroup controllers from the cgroups filesystem.

methods.name: needAnyControllers
methods.description: Determines if any supported controllers should be enabled based on resources.

methods.name: containsDomainController
methods.description: Checks if the resource configuration includes domain controllers like memory, io, cpu, or hugetlb.

methods.name: CreateCgroupPath
methods.description: Creates a cgroup v2 path and enables all supported controllers, handling various cgroup states.
